name: QUMem

paper.title: QUMem: Personalized Memory for Query-Conditioned User-State Inference in LLM Agents

construction.unit: atomic typed memory, linked to a variable-length episode
construction.processing: LLM decomposes each episode into factual, preference, insight memories (3 calls)
construction.writer: LLM decomposer; Qwen3.5-4B SFT continuity classifier sets episode boundaries

organization.structure: three typed stores linked to source episodes

retrieval.query: A1 identifies information needs; A2 rewrites them into multiple queries
retrieval.candidates: A2 routes each query to chosen typed stores; merge and deduplicate
retrieval.selection: A3 selects task-relevant evidence into a user state

use.context: query-conditioned user state: chronological facts, preference evolution, insights
use.reasoning: three sequential agents, then downstream response model

stages.ingestion: A lightweight continuity classifier (fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-4B on LoCoMo-derived data) decides for each pair of adjacent user utterances whether they belong to the same event, producing variable-length dialogue episodes.
stages.construction: Each finished episode is decomposed by an LLM, called three times (once per type), into atomic factual, preference and transferable-insight memories, each with its temporal position and source turns; the episode itself is retained as context.
stages.organization: Three typed memory stores (F, P, I) linked back to source episodes.
stages.retrieval: Information-Need Agent identifies what must be verified; Retrieval Planning Agent rewrites needs into queries and routes each to one or more typed stores (top-k=5 per retrieval); results are merged and deduplicated.
stages.answer: User-State Inference Agent composes a query-conditioned user state (chronological facts, preference evolution, applicable insights) that is given with the query to the response model.
stages.learning: Only the episode-boundary classifier is fine-tuned (SFT); the rest is prompt-based.

summary: Semantic-continuity episodes decomposed into typed fact/preference/insight memories, with a three-agent query-conditioned pipeline that infers a temporally valid user state for personalization.
notes:
